description.en: A titanium command vessel for an original next-generation spacecraft fleet.
description.zh: 以钛金属指挥舰，呈现原创次世代太空舰队。

description.en: Three staggered chevron approach vectors, broken range arcs and docking alignment ticks connect mission-based fleet formations and engineering archives. This geometry is specific to Zeppelin.
description.zh: 错落的接近向量、测距弧与对接刻度压印在冷调工程纸上，呼应任务编队与舰船工程档案。

transform.method: Uniformly fit complete motif linework into 432px, leaving a transparent 40px tile perimeter. No clipped paths or recolored project artwork.

hero.method: Authored canvas composition of the complete approved foreground and project-specific supporting texture; no new model call during kit assembly, no crop or recolor

sourceScope: Owner-delegated acceptance authorizes creation, source adoption and publication for Zeppelin. Product UI tokens and documented fleet designs remain unchanged.

appliesTo: hexly.ai project introduction and brand archive
Hexly-authored promotional video, deck, social and campaign material
scope.officialProjectIdentity: Preserve the adopted shape, proportions, native material colors and exact file bytes.
scope.campaignInterpretation: The source-adopted spacecraft is reused without recoloring. Wide/mobile layouts and vector surface motifs are separate authored compositions.
scope.localAccent: Use sampled artwork accents without modifying the Logo.

campaignInterpretation.description: The agent-inspected, source-adopted foreground is reused unchanged under the named-project review waiver; no owner review of exact bytes is claimed.
